summary: ProjeQtOr is a multi-user project management system designed to handle all phases of a project lifecycle. It provides collaborative tooling to help teams plan, track, and manage complex tasks within a single web-based interface.
goodFor: It suits organisations looking for an open-source project management suite to coordinate multiple users and workflows on self-hosted infrastructure.
watchOut: The software is distributed under the AGPL-3.0 licence, which places strict copyleft obligations on network services, and project activity metrics indicate low recent development momentum.
deployNotes: As a PHP application, it will typically require a standard web server like Apache or Nginx, alongside a relational database such as MySQL or MariaDB and persistent storage for uploaded files.
